evidence_span.text: A prominent oval cell proliferation (also known as the ductular reaction) was observed in LKOs of both sexes, where the severity correlated with inflammation (mononuclear and granular inflammatory cells) and fibrosis

reviews.rationale: Hepatocyte-specific Cyp51 knockout in mouse liver causally produces oval-cell-driven injury, inflammation and fibrosis with compensatory cholesterogenic changes, supporting CYP51's essential in vivo hepatic cholesterol-synthesis role in the target context. Tm7sf2 appears only as one entry in a compensatory qPCR panel, which is not gene-specific investigation, so it is not credited.

evidence_span.text: Nevertheless, HSCs were sensitive to FC accumulation because the high intracellular expression ratio of SREBP cleavage-activating protein (Scap) to insulin-induced gene (Insig) disrupted the SREBP2-mediated feedback regulation of cholesterol homeostasis in these cells.

reviews.rationale: The paper directly reports the SCAP:INSIG ratio disrupting SREBP2-mediated cholesterol-homeostasis feedback in a NASH model, supporting the regulator mechanism with no supplied-gene coverage. The finding is in hepatic stellate cells rather than the target hepatocytes, so the declared direct context is overclaimed (indirect).

evidence_span.text: iDGAT1 and iDGAT2 treatments alone reduced TG content alongside DGAT1 and DGAT2 mRNA levels without showing significant differences across the tested doses (25, 50, 100 µM) (Figure S1A,B).

reviews.rationale: Pharmacological DGAT2 inhibition causally reduced triglyceride content in a MASLD-like system, supporting DGAT2's regulator role with no supplied-gene coverage. The paper's own experiments use human HepG2 hepatoma cells in vitro rather than mouse hepatocytes, so the declared partial context is overclaimed (indirect).

evidence_span.text: Acyl-CoA:cholesterol acyltransferase 1 and 2 (ACAT1 and ACAT2) convert various sterols to steryl esters; their activities are activated by cholesterol.

reviews.rationale: ACAT2's cholesterol-esterification function appears only as an established background statement; the paper's ACAT2-specific experiments (KO mice) concern pregnenolone esterification in adrenal/non-hepatic settings and find no PREG-ester change. Because the cited function is background-only here, Acat2 is not credited as studied or function-supported, leaving only partial associative support.
